dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: The new concurrent AWS staging simulation exposed another cross-process state boundary: with three web tasks, 7 of 9 personas lost their sign-in because identity/session state was loaded once per process. Session read-through is fixed, but the simulation is temporarily constrained to one web task until the remaining repositories are proven safe across multiple copies, and there is not yet a clean full post-fix rerun on the current main.

dimensions.name: Customer acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: The acquisition surface is now much stronger, including a sellable $395 audit, a real audit-to-$795-website credit/upsell, faster background research, premium dashboard parity and live Stripe infrastructure. But there is still no repeatable real-traffic to paid Business Builder customer loop, no measured CAC, and no verified external conversion cohort.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: There is still no verified paying Business Builder cohort, recurring Business Builder MRR, measured CAC, gross margin, retention, or paid-delivery economics. Internal/founder tests, synthetic personas, Stripe test flows and implementation depth do not count as external economic proof.

changed: The biggest positive change is that the $395 existing-business audit has become a real end-to-end Business Builder product wedge rather than a marketing concept: the engine, evidence-backed report, PDF/sample, human review console, business-aware website checks, 60-day audit credit and fixed-price $795 website upsell are merged on canonical main, while background research now runs concurrently with live progress. The main negative change is reliability evidence: the newer cloud simulation found that 7 of 9 personas lost their session when staging scaled to three API copies, exposing another process-local state boundary. The session read-through fix is merged, but the simulation is intentionally back to one web task until the remaining repositories are proven multi-copy safe, so reliability is marked down despite the fix.
method: Business Builder/SelfOperate-only independent forecast grounded in the 2026-09-28 canonical dariusstrongman/businessbuilder main through 759f3e9, recent merged audit/research/dashboard/workforce work including PRs #277-#298, the AWS staging persona-simulation evidence and multi-copy session regression/fix through 5c6f21e, prior live Stripe/worker/customer-journey evidence, the unchanged transitional website-builder repository, and only directly relevant Stromation website-engine evidence through 974d11c (first-screen quality contract) plus c1b278c (three directions/four business-order revision rounds). The archived buisnessbuilder-future repository is treated as historical architecture evidence only. Merged implementation is distinguished from deployed/live proof. Unrelated Stromation ventures, company-wide autonomy and Stromation customer/revenue status are excluded. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
